saw.short: Waitrose's Christmas ad with Keira Knightley premieres today
saw.headline: *Waitrose’s Christmas ad* with Keira Knightley premieres today
saw.what: Waitrose is due to premiere its Christmas ad with Keira Knightley and Joe Wilkinson on YouTube at 6.30am today, a follow-up to last year’s romcom, per Digital Spy. A teaser on 5 Nov showed Knightley running down a Waitrose aisle in a wedding dress. Shorter 60-second and 30-second trailers and film-style posters are due to follow. We haven’t seen the full ad or any reaction figures.
saw.why: A teaser, a date card and a sequel. The build-up is the story until the ad lands.

saw.short: Disney's Christmas short The Invisible Horse lands
saw.headline: Disney’s Christmas short *The Invisible Horse* lands
saw.what: Disney’s Christmas short “The Invisible Horse”, directed by Dougal Wilson, landed on 9 Nov on Disney+ and YouTube. It follows a boy who has outgrown Christmas. Metro says a Make-A-Wish tie-in runs across the UK and Ireland. Laughing Place confirms the release, and the previous two shorts were directed by Taika Waititi.
saw.why: A big brand Christmas film arrives early in the season. Disney’s the benchmark for family ads.

saw.short: David Schwimmer revives Ross's red sweater in an ad
saw.headline: *David Schwimmer* revives Ross’s red sweater in an ad
saw.what: David Schwimmer, 60, hunts for a red sweater in a Christmas ad for Quince, a callback to the Friends episode “The One With the Red Sweater”. Metro reports it is Quince’s first UK campaign. Quince teased it on Instagram on 6 Nov. The ad doesn’t name Friends, per Metro.
saw.why: A 25-year-old joke does the work. Nostalgia travels well on social.

saw.short: Selfridges opens a GTA 6 pop-up on Oxford Street
saw.headline: Selfridges opens a *GTA 6 pop-up* on Oxford Street
saw.what: Selfridges opened a GTA 6-themed pop-up on Oxford Street on 9 Nov with around 60 exclusive items, including a £2,500 varsity jacket, Metro reports. Metro says much of it sold out and neither Selfridges nor Rockstar had announced it in advance. GTA 6 launches on 19 Nov.
saw.why: Game launches now come with retail moments. Queues and sell-outs make good content.

saw.short: Skims offers refunds after advent calendar backlash
saw.headline: *Skims* offers refunds after advent calendar backlash
saw.what: Skims says it has contacted every buyer of its $148 accessories advent calendar and offered a full refund or Skims credit, per a statement to Metro. IBTimes UK puts the UK price at £158. Unboxing videos on TikTok and Instagram called the contents poor value.
saw.why: Value for money drives viral reactions. A fast brand response is the lesson.

platform.short: Instagram's Effect Builder lets people create AI effects, US-only
platform.headline: Instagram’s *Effect Builder* creates AI effects, US-only for now
platform.what: Instagram has launched Effect Builder, a web tool where people describe an AI effect for Stories. Effects are reviewed for safety and link back to the creator’s profile. The Edits blog says it is available in the US for people over 18, so it isn’t in the UK yet.
platform.why: Instagram is letting creators build effects. Not usable in the UK yet.
platform.source: Instagram Edits blog, 9 Nov; Social Media Today, 9 Nov

platform.short: LinkedIn explains how its feed finds posts from people you don't follow
platform.headline: LinkedIn explains how its feed finds *posts from people you don’t follow*
platform.what: LinkedIn’s engineering blog says its Profile Relevance system uses LLM embeddings to match posts from outside your network to your professional profile. LinkedIn says it cut feed hide rates by 18.8% in tests, with a 0.94% rise in viral rate.
platform.why: Your profile helps decide what the feed shows you. Good to know for anyone running a page.
platform.source: LinkedIn Engineering, 9 Nov; Social Media Today, 9 Nov
